notes.title: Exciting News: Roborne Demo & OST Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Robornes,[/h1]

We are thrilled to share some exciting news with you! After two and a half years of dedicated development, Roborne is almost here. But that's not all—we're bringing you a special treat ahead of the official release.

[h2]Mark Your Calendars: September 4, 2024[/h2]

On this date, you’ll get exclusive access to both the [b]Roborne Demo[/b] and [b]Original Soundtrack (OST)[/b], a full week before the official game launch on [b]September 11th[/b]. This early release will give you the chance to dive into the game and experience its captivating music before anyone else.

[h3]Don’t miss out on this early opportunity to engage with Roborne. Be sure to add the date to your calendar, wishlist the game, and stay tuned for more updates.[/h3]

[b][h3]Looking forward to seeing you at the factory![/h3][/b]


[i]Best regards,

Jayden Neuendorf
Lead Director, NSG[/i]
